_comment: Question wording for the v1.3 research-tools discovery set. Scores, categories, frustration ratings and paper question-counts all come from runs.json / pubs_runs.json; only the prose of each question is missing there, and Table 1 needs it. Canonical source is the benchmark itself (nf-osi/asta-bench); this copy was read off the published dashboard.

text.AB-002: Find antibodies targeting the C-terminal region of neurofibromin
text.AB-003: Give me antibodies for studying NF1 phosphorylation and post-translational regulation

text.AM-002: Help me find animal models suitable for energy expenditure studies
text.AM-003: Are there any non-mouse mammalian models available?
